DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-DRACONIC_BLOODLINE_REL:
ACT1: Gain 12 max HP.
ACT2: Gain 1 [gold]flight[/gold], refreshes when resting.
ACT3: Once per turn, after playing 4 [gold]Element[/gold] cards, gain 12 [gold]Block[/gold].
Draconic ancestral blood flows through you.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-DIVINE_SCALES_RELIC.de: Whenever you apply an [gold]Elemental[/gold] debuff, apply 1 more of it.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-DIVINE_SCALES_RELIC.fl: The dragon within you... set it free..
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-WILD_MAGIC_RELIC.descr:
ACT1: When a [gold]Spellslot[/gold] reaches 0, add a random spell 
from your draw pile into your hand.
ACT2: Gain [gold]Potency[/gold] based on the amount of Status cards in your deck.
ACT3: Generating a Status grants 1 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-WILD_MAGIC_RELIC.flavo: The power of the weave cannot be mastered, it is unpredictable
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-WILD_MAGIC_RELIC.title: Wild Magic
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-FIRE_OF_CREATION_RELIC: That what burns turns into a new story.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-LUNAR_SORCERER_RELIC.d:
ACT1: Once per combat, when [gold]Metamagic[/gold] reaches 0, gain 2 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
ACT2: Heal 5hp when the last kill in an encounter is from Spell attack damage.
ACT3: Playing a [gold]Scrolled[/gold] spell or a spell affected by your [gold]Metamagic[/gold] you draw 1 card.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-LUNAR_SORCERER_RELIC.f: Power from the heavens, right in your veins!
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-MOONLIGHT_CRYSTAL_RELI: Cards affected by your [gold]Metamagic[/gold] cannot be exhausted.
Illuminated by the moonlight, your magic is boundless,
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-BATTLE_MASTER_RELIC.de:
ACT1: At the start of combat, select a [gold]Maneuver[/gold].
ACT2: At the end of your turn, select a card to [gold]Retain[/gold] for a turn.
ACT3: After playing [gold]Action Surge[/gold], gain a [gold]Maneuver[/gold].
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-BATTLE_MASTER_RELIC.se: Choose a card to [gold]Retain[/gold] this turn.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-BATTLE_MASTER_RELIC.fl: He knows what kind of thing you are..
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-MASTERS_MANUAL_RELIC.d: [gold]Maneuvers[/gold] you create are upgraded, gain a random [gold]Maneuver[/gold] at the start of every turn.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-ECHO_KNIGHT_RELIC.desc:
ACT1: After gaining [gold]Second Wind[/gold], your next attack is played twice (relic flash).
ACT2: At the start of combat, play the bottom card of your draw pile.
ACT3: After playing [gold]Action Surge[/gold], put a copy of the next card you play into your draw pile.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-ECHO_KNIGHT_RELIC.flav: In and Out. In and Out.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-PULSATING_HANDGUARD_RE: After gaining [gold]Second Wind[/gold], a random card gains 1 [gold]Replay[/gold].
Many attacks, too little time... lets fix that.
ACT1: Gain half-caster [gold]Spellslots[/gold]. Select 3 of 9 common or uncommon [gold]Spells[/gold] to add to your deck at Neow and change them at Rest Sites.
ACT2: Drawing a [gold]Spell[/gold] grants 3 [gold]Vigor[/gold].
ACT3: After playing a [gold]Spell[/gold], give a random enemy [gold]Vulnerable[/gold]
Oh man i hope i can transmutate lead like this...
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-CLEARMETAL_BLADE_RELIC: Choose up to 6 out of 18 [gold]Spells[/gold], gain double [gold]Spellslots[/gold]
Forged in Elven moonwater, this blade channels the winds itself..
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-ASSASSIN_RELIC.title: Assassin
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-ASSASSIN_RELIC.descrip:
ACT1: The first [gold]Attack[/gold] you play each combat deals double damage.
ACT2: Whenever you enter a [gold]?[/gold] room, gain 4 [gold]Vigor[/gold] at the start of your next combat.
ACT3: Entering [gold]Hidden[/gold] grants 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] and 1 [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-LEECHING_KNIFE_RELIC.d: If an enemy dies on the first turn, play your most expensive Power.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-LEECHING_KNIFE_RELIC.f: I'm not playing nice. Especially after I just murked your little friend over there.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-ARCANE_TRICKSTER_RELIC:
ACT1: choose 2 of 5 [gold]Spells[/gold] at Neow and change them at Rest Sites, They gain [gold]Retain[/gold].
ACT2: While [gold]Hidden[/gold], you have 5 [gold]Ability Potency[/gold].
ACT3: After you cast a spell, all enemies lose 3 [gold]Strength[/gold] for a turn.
Choose 2 spells to start combat with.
Magic is just another lock to pick.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-GHOST_GLOVES_RELIC.des: While [gold]Hidden[/gold], your spells do not create [gold]Arcane Exhaustion[/gold].
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-GHOST_GLOVES_RELIC.fla: Obtained LEGALLY from a WILLINGLY wizard...
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-THIEF_RELIC.title: Thief
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-THIEF_RELIC.descriptio:
ACT1: Damage you take outside of combat is halved.
ACT2: If you end combat [gold]Hidden[/gold], gain 25% more [gold]Gold[/gold].
ACT3: At the start of an [gold]Elite[/gold] or [gold]Boss[/gold] combat, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(2)} and 20 [gold]Block[/gold].
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-THIEF_RELIC.flavor: What's yours is mine, and what's mine is also mine.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-GOLDEN_KEY_RELIC.title: Golden Key
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-GOLDEN_KEY_RELIC.descr: Whenever you enter [gold]Hidden[/gold], [gold]Upgrade[/gold] a random card in your hand.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-BESERKER_RELIC.descrip:
ACT1: At the start of your turn while [gold]Raged[/gold], a random 1 cost attack in your hand is free to play.
Act2: Weak is 50% less effective on your while [gold]Raged[/gold].
Act3: once a turn, when losing HP from an enemy attack play a random attack card from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-BESERKER_RELIC.flavor: You have mad.. and then you MAD!!!..
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-BESERKER_RELIC.title: Beserker
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-HOPIUM_RELIC.descripti:
[gold]Weak[/gold] has no effect on you while [gold]Raged[/gold].
Instead of losing [gold]Rage[/gold] when playing a power, you lose [gold]Weak[/gold] instead if present.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-HOPIUM_RELIC.flavor: WE WILL MAKE IT!! I BELIEVE!!!!
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-HOPIUM_RELIC.title: Hopium
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-GIANT_RELIC.descriptio:
ACT1: At the start of your turn while [gold]Raged[/gold], a random attack in your hand gain a 1 [gold]Use[/gold] 2 strength Lightning or fire [gold]Dip[/gold].
Act2: Applying [gold]Reverb[/gold] or [gold]Shocked[/gold] gives you 2 [gold]Block[/gold].
Act3: Attacks with a [gold]Lightning/Thunder[/gold] [gold]Dip[/gold] don't lose Use when hitting targets with [gold]Shocked/Reverb[/gold].
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-GIANT_RELIC.flavor: My hand reaches the skies, for my might will strike you!
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-GIANT_RELIC.title: Giant's Path
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-MINIATURE_MOUNTAIN_REL: When you Attack an enemy without [gold]Reverb[/gold], apply one [gold]Reverb[/gold] to it.
Even on this tiny rock, the world beneath it trembles.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-TOTEM_WARRIOR_RELIC.de:
ACT1: Upon entering [gold]Rage[/gold], gain a random [gold]Rage Spirit[/gold].
Act2: Whenever you take damage outside of combat, you start the next two combats with 2 extra [gold]Energy[/gold].
Act3: You [gold]Rage Spirits[/gold] are enhanced.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-TOTEM_WARRIOR_RELIC.fl: Omg I love animals!! VERSUS... THE SPIRITS GUIDE MY UNYIELDING RAGE!!!
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-FIFTH_COLUMN_RELIC.des: upon reaching 5 [gold]Rage[/gold], gain another random [gold]Rage Spirit[/gold].
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-GREAT_ONE_RELIC.descri:
ACT1: Whenever you spend energy playing a [gold]Cantrip[/gold], draw 1 card.
ACT2: Gain 2 extra [gold]Otherworldy Patron Slots[/gold].
ACT3: After playing 3 cantrips, gain a missing [gold]Spellslot[/gold].
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-GREAT_ONE_RELIC.flavor: I'm serving the greatest one with my upmost loyalty.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-GREAT_ONE_RELIC.title: Great Old One
